verdict.rationale: Stripe documents crypto acceptance as simply enabling the Crypto payment method, with payments settling as fiat in the Stripe balance. Stripe also handles stablecoin conversion and payout, and offers hosted, embedded, and mobile-SDK onramp integrations. All of this means developers integrate through Stripe's conventional API surface (with CLI, sandbox, MCP and webhooks) rather than running chain infrastructure. missing for 10: explicit documentation that gas fees, nodes and chain mechanics are fully abstracted, documented language client libraries for the crypto APIs (only a mobile SDK and an npm hint appear), a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the integration experience.
